# Agile SciTech

> Agile SciTech Pvt. Ltd. (formerly Agile Diagnostics, established 2013, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India) is an authorised channel partner in India for Welch Materials, Bio-Techne, Unchained Labs, FlowCam, RainSure, Inscinstech, TLC Pharmaceutical Standards and Ajinomoto CELLiST Korea. It supplies chromatography columns and consumables, preparative and bioprocess systems, biologics characterization instruments, digital PCR, reagents, reference standards and cell culture media, with demo, installation, training and service by its own field team.

Contact: sales@agilescitech.in, info@agilescitech.in, phone +91-88661-01022. Address: B-402, S.G. Business Hub, S.G. Highway, Ahmedabad 380060, Gujarat, India.

## Main pages

- [Agile SciTech](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/): Agile SciTech: authorised partner in India for Welch Materials, Bio-Techne, Unchained Labs, FlowCam, RainSure, Inscinstech, TLC and Ajinomoto CELLiST.
- [Products](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/products.html): Product catalogue: 101 product lines in 12 categories from eight global partners, supplied and supported by Agile SciTech.
- [Applications](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/applications.html): Twelve laboratory applications with the full workflow, the products for each step and the partners that supply them.
- [About us](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/about.html): Agile SciTech, founded in 2013 in Ahmedabad: authorised channel partner for global chromatography and life science brands. Awards, certificates and events.

## Partners

- [Ajinomoto CELLiST Korea](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-ajinomoto-cellist-korea.html): Basal media, feeds and supplements developed with Ajinomoto’s amino-acid science — compatible with CHO-K1, CHO-GS, CHO-S, CHO-DG44 and CHO-DXB11 cell lines.
- [Bio-Techne](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-bio-techne.html): R&D Systems reagents for discovery labs, GMP proteins for cell and gene therapy, and automated Simple Western, Ella and Maurice platforms for biologics.
- [FlowCam](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-flowcam.html): FlowCam images each particle as it flows past, then counts, sizes and classifies it, so you know not just how many particles there are but what they are.
- [Inscinstech](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-inscinstech.html): Oligonucleotide synthesis, chromatography, prep HPLC, crossflow filtration, bioreactors and LNP assembly: one platform family from upstream to analytics.
- [RainSure](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-rainsure.html): Compact all-in-one dPCR systems with ready multiplex assays for residual DNA, viral titre, copy number and rare-mutation detection in biopharma labs.
- [TLC Pharmaceutical Standards](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-tlc-pharmaceutical-standards.html): 24,000+ characterised impurities and stable isotope-labelled standards, each with a full Certificate of Analysis, plus custom synthesis when you need it.
- [Unchained Labs](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-unchained-labs.html): Plate-based instruments that measure stability, size, concentration and viscosity from microlitres, plus nanoparticle synthesis from screening to GMP.
- [Welch Materials](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/partner-welch-materials.html): Analytical and prep HPLC and GC columns, prep LC and DAC, purification media, sample prep and lab consumables from one supplier, with application support.

## Product categories

- [Biologics characterization](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-biologics-characterization.html): Measure concentration, size, stability, viscosity, charge and purity of proteins, vectors and nanoparticles with Unchained Labs, Bio-Techne and Inscinstech.
- [Bioprocess systems](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-bioprocess-systems.html): Inscinstech systems for oligo, mRNA, peptide and protein manufacturing: synthesis, purification, filtration, cell culture and LNP assembly, lab to plant.
- [Cell culture media & feeds](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-cell-culture-media-feeds.html): Ajinomoto CELLiST basal media, feeds and supplements for CHO-based antibody production and viral vector manufacturing.
- [Digital PCR & molecular](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-digital-pcr-molecular.html): RainSure digital and real-time PCR systems, ready assays and reagents for absolute quantification and rare-target detection.
- [HPLC, UHPLC & GC columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-hplc-uhplc-gc-columns.html): Welch Materials analytical columns — reversed-phase, chiral, HILIC, ion-exchange, SEC and GC — in 1.8–10 µm particles and USP L1–L134 classifications.
- [Lab consumables & equipment](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-lab-consumables-equipment.html): Everyday chromatography supplies from Welch (Welchrom® and Doprah): vials, closures, syringe filters, membranes, bottles and tools, plus the WelView reactor.
- [Particle imaging](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-particle-imaging.html): FlowCam flow imaging microscopes and software to image, count and classify particles in biopharma, water and materials samples.
- [Preparative, flash & DAC](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-preparative-flash-dac.html): Prep and flash columns, packing materials, Sail 1000 lab systems, WelPacker DAC and explosion-proof skids. 100+ Welch purification installations in India.
- [Protein purification media](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-protein-purification-media.html): Welch agarose, dextran and inorganic resins, prepacked WK-Col and empty columns for affinity, ion-exchange, HIC and gel filtration chromatography.
- [Reagents & ELISA](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-reagents-elisa.html): Bio-Techne antibodies, proteins, immunoassays, small molecules and spatial biology reagents — delivered through a temperature-controlled supply chain.
- [Reference standards](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-reference-standards.html): TLC Pharmaceutical Standards — 24,000+ characterised compounds from an ISO 17034 / 17025 / 9001 manufacturer, each supplied with a full Certificate of Analysis.
- [Sample preparation](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/cat-sample-preparation.html): Welch SPE cartridges and plates in 80+ phases, QuEChERS kits, immunoaffinity and IC cartridges, and the manifold and pump to run them.

## Applications

- [Bioanalysis & LC-MS](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-bioanalysis-lc-ms.html): Quantify drugs and biomarkers in plasma and tissue: inert-hardware columns for stronger MS signal, isotope-labelled standards and automated immunoassays.
- [Biologics developability](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-biologics-developability.html): Pick candidates that survive manufacturing and storage. Screen stability, aggregation, viscosity, charge variants and particles early, from microlitres.
- [Cell & gene therapy](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-cell-gene-therapy.html): Six partners, one workflow: GMP reagents and media for production, nanoparticle formulation, and the analytics to measure titre, particle quality and purity.
- [Digital PCR & molecular quantification](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-digital-pcr.html): Count DNA and RNA molecules directly, with no standard curve: residual DNA, rare mutations, copy number and pathogen detection, plus spatial RNA in tissue.
- [Downstream purification](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-downstream-purification.html): Capture, polish, concentrate and buffer-exchange proteins, antibodies, peptides and oligos with systems, prep HPLC, TFF and columns that scale to the plant.
- [Food & environmental testing](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-food-residue-testing.html): Pesticides, mycotoxins and contaminants in food, feed, soil and water: QuEChERS, SPE and immunoaffinity clean-up, then GC and HPLC columns for trace work.
- [Oligo, mRNA & peptide manufacturing](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-oligo-mrna-peptide.html): From solid-phase synthesis to purified, formulated product: synthesizers, prep chromatography, TFF and LNP assembly that scale from lab to production.
- [Pharma QC & impurity analysis](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-pharma-qc.html): Robust HPLC/UHPLC methods, certified impurity standards and the instruments to run them, for QC and ARD release testing, stability studies and filings.
- [Protein & cell biology research](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-protein-cell-research.html): Antibodies, recombinant proteins, small molecules and immunoassays for discovery labs, plus automated protein analysis and spatial biology.
- [Subvisible particle analysis](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-subvisible-particles.html): Light obscuration counts particles; flow imaging shows what they are: protein aggregates, silicone oil, air bubbles or foreign matter. Find the root cause.
- [Upstream cell culture](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-upstream-cell-culture.html): Higher antibody titres start with the right media and a controlled bioreactor: CELLiST basal media, feeds and supplements with lab-scale bioreactors.
- [Water & environmental monitoring](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/app-water-environment.html): Automate microscope counts of algae, cyanobacteria and plankton. FlowCam images every cell so labs identify and count organisms faster and more reliably.

- [Custom instrumentation & system engineering](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/service-custom.html): For unique applications or facility constraints, we offer tailored instrument development and system customization.
- [Process & technology engineering](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/service-process-engineering.html): We help clients select, configure and integrate the right technologies for efficient and compliant bioprocess and purification operations.
- [Facility planning & end-to-end turnkey execution](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/service-turnkey.html): We design operational spaces that enhance workflow efficiency and meet global quality and safety standards.

## Products


### HPLC, UHPLC & GC columns

- [Ultisil® / Ultimate series](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-ultisil-ultimate-series.html) (Welch Materials): Silica-based columns with a broad range of phases for small-molecule methods.
- [Xtimate® series](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-xtimate-series.html) (Welch Materials): Hybrid silica, pH 1.0–12.5, for robust methods on acidic, basic and neutral compounds.
- [Topsil series](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-topsil-series.html) (Welch Materials): Silica columns in Top-C18, Top-C8 and Top-Phenyl-Hexyl selectivities.
- [Welchrom® series](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-welchrom-series.html) (Welch Materials): General-purpose C18 and C8 columns for routine separations.
- [Boltimate® core-shell](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-boltimate-core-shell.html) (Welch Materials): Core-shell particles (e.g. Bol-C18, Bol-HILIC) for fast, high-efficiency runs.
- [Blossmate® chiral](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-blossmate-chiral.html) (Welch Materials): Cellu-D, Cellu-J, Amy-D, IMMA and IMMB chiral phases, analytical to prep.
- [Advanchrom® C18](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-advanchrom-c18.html) (Welch Materials): pH 1.0–12.5, 180 Å, USP L1; anti-fouling and highly reproducible — food, herbal and pharma QC.
- [Advanchrom® HIC-Butyl / Bio HIC-Butyl](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-advanchrom-hic-butyl-bio-hic-butyl.html) (Welch Materials): 1000 Å butyl phases for antibodies, proteins and ADC DAR analysis; MS-compatible mobile phases.
- [Advanchrom® Amine & SCX](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-advanchrom-amine-scx.html) (Welch Materials): Amine column for sugars by ELSD (ChP 2025 Poria cocos method); SCX for proteins.
- [DLC columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-dlc-columns.html) (Welch Materials): Diamond-like carbon coated hardware that reduces metal interaction.
- [HILIC, IEX, SEC, HIC & mixed-mode](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-hilic-iex-sec-hic-mixed-mode.html) (Welch Materials): Amide, NH2, diol, ion-exchange, size-exclusion, HIC and mixed-mode columns.
- [Ghost-Buster™ columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-ghost-buster-columns.html) (Welch Materials): Ghost-Buster, II, UP (100 MPa) and Plus; kits with PEEK fittings.
- [GC columns — WM series](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-gc-columns-wm-series.html) (Welch Materials): High-performance capillary GC: WM-1, -5, -17, -624, -1701, MS, WAX/FFAP and PLOT.
- [GC columns — WEL series](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-gc-columns-wel-series.html) (Welch Materials): Economical capillary GC columns in common phases (WEL-1, -5, -624, -1701…).

### Preparative, flash & DAC

- [PrepPack Ultisil® prep columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-preppack-ultisil-prep-columns.html) (Welch Materials): C18, C8, C4, C1, phenyl, CN, NH2, diol, SAX, SCX, AQ-C18; 5, 10, 20 and 40–70 µm.
- [PrepPack Xtimate® prep columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-preppack-xtimate-prep-columns.html) (Welch Materials): pH 1.0–12.5; C18, C8, SiO2, NH2, phenyl-hexyl, CN; 5 and 10 µm.
- [Blossmate® chiral prep columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-blossmate-chiral-prep-columns.html) (Welch Materials): Cellu-D, Cellu-J, Amy-D, IMMA and IMMB; 10, 21.2, 30 and 50 mm ID.
- [WelFlash® flash cartridges](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-welflash-flash-cartridges.html) (Welch Materials): Silica, C18, phenyl, CN, NH2, diol, HILIC, SAX, SCX; 4 g to 1600 g and custom.
- [Chromatography packing materials](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-chromatography-packing-materials.html) (Welch Materials): Bonded and chiral silica, 5–70 µm, from kilograms to ton scale.
- [Sail 1000 modular prep LC system](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-sail-1000-modular-prep-lc-system.html) (Welch Materials): Pumps from 10 mL/min to 3 L/min, dual-wavelength UV-Vis and CDS with audit trails.
- [Sail 1000 collectors & accessories](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-sail-1000-collectors-accessories.html) (Welch Materials): 8-channel and 120-position fraction collectors, autosampler, column rack, online filters.
- [WelPacker DAC columns](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-welpacker-dac-columns.html) (Welch Materials): DAC50 to DAC2000 self-packing dynamic axial compression columns, 316L SS.
- [WelPacker purification skids LC5–LC80](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-welpacker-purification-skids-lc5-lc80.html) (Welch Materials): 5–80 L/min, 100 bar, explosion-proof Ex d II B T4, PLC + HMI control.
- [Preparative HPLC system (lab)](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-preparative-hplc-system-lab.html) (Inscinstech): Lab-scale prep HPLC for peptides, oligos and small molecules.
- [Pilot-scale preparative LC system](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-pilot-scale-preparative-lc-system.html) (Inscinstech): Pilot-scale prep liquid chromatography for scale-up batches.

### Particle imaging

- [FlowCam 8000](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-flowcam-8000.html) (FlowCam): High-resolution flow imaging for all-round particle characterization.
- [FlowCam LO](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-flowcam-lo.html) (FlowCam): Flow imaging plus light obscuration in one instrument.
- [FlowCam Nano](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-flowcam-nano.html) (FlowCam): Submicron particle imaging for protein therapeutics.
- [FlowCam 5000](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-flowcam-5000.html) (FlowCam): Streamlined, entry-level flow imaging.
- [FlowCam Cyano](https://meetbhavsar777.github.io/agile-website-simple/product-flowcam-cyano.html) (FlowCam): Differentiates cyanobacteria from other algae.
